analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: We may disclose, share, transmit, disclose, grant access to, make available, and provide personal information with and to internal and external recipients, as follows: Palo Alto Networks Companies... Customers... Other LIVEcommunity and Blog Users... Contests, Sweepstakes, and Survey Providers... Marketing Providers... Customer Service and Communication Providers... Other Service Providers... Ad Networks and Advertising Partners... Business Partners... Your Employer / Company... Business Transaction or Reorganization... Legal Obligations and Rights... With Your Consent.

analysis.headline: Partners Share Your Data
analysis.quote: We will share personal information, or any information collected through the Services with those marketing partners in order to help them send you information that we believe will be of interest to you.

analysis.headline: Records Your Mouse Movements
analysis.quote: These tools may also record information you enter when you interact with our Services or engage in chat features through our Services.

analysis.headline: Infers Your Preferences
analysis.quote: We infer new information from other data we collect, including using automated means to generate information about your likely preferences or other characteristics ("Inferences").

analysis.headline: Retains Data for Legal Claims
analysis.quote: We may need to apply a “legal hold” that retains information beyond our typical retention period where we face threat of legal claim or intent to establish a claim.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: The personal information we collect may be transferred to and stored in countries outside of the jurisdiction you are in to locations where we and our third-party service providers have operations, including in the United States of America.

analysis.headline: Opt-out Does Not Cover All
analysis.quote: You may not opt-out of Services-related communications (e.g., account verification, transactional communications, changes/updates to features of the Services, technical and security notices).

analysis.headline: Receives Data From Employer
analysis.quote: If you interact with our Services through your employer or company, we may receive your information from your employer or company, including another representative of your employer or company.

analysis.headline: Implied Consent for Marketing
analysis.quote: Wherever you consent to the processing, for example when you sign up for our newsletters or events, request a demo, free trial or a download, or submit a survey. Here, your consent is implied, meaning that you consent by submitting a particular form to us.
